The left and right edges show narrow brown and orange cliff-wall flanks (rows 2-31) with a dark inner edge, and green grass verges at rows 32-47. The wall flanks are the only vertical-looking parts and they sit beside the ramp, not in front of it. The tile reads as a flat top-down ramp surface with side walls, not as a 3/4 block with a front face.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate shows 10 visible tones per tile, against 3 for the grass reference and 7 for the paving reference. It is a little more striped and less clumped than the Beodeul grass, but it is not flat or shallow and would sit acceptably next to the references.
